messages.text: Our dad died and left the house in his will. My sister A wants to buy it with her husband at a "family discount". I'm not signing off on that. Our younger sister B could use some money too. Can you help us sort this out?

I’m not sure what the will says. I’d like to buy the house with my husband at a family discount, but only if C agrees. No price, valuation, terms, or timing are settled; I’m not ready to sign anything and would like time to get advice.

Thank you. I’m not sure what the will says about the house. I’d need some money from it to start a dance studio; timing matters, though I don’t have a firm amount or date in mind. I could consider A buying it at a fair, independently assessed value, with terms agreed by all of us, but I know C hasn’t agreed. I’d like time to get advice before signing anything.

I don’t know what the will says, and no price or terms are settled. I need a fair financial share and won’t subsidize a discounted purchase. I could consider a sale to A at an independent valuation with terms all three agree to. I’m not in a rush, but I want it resolved fairly. I’d like time to get advice; please pause signing anything.
No. I still want a family discount, but only with C’s agreement. I don’t have a copy of the will yet, and I want advice before signing anything.

Yes, in principle, to an independent valuation with no family discount and agreed terms. I can’t give a firm amount or date yet; the timeline needs to account for my studio plans. I’d like advice and a copy of the will before signing.
Not yet. I support an independent valuation, but I can’t confirm it meets my fair-share concern until I’ve seen the will and agreed the terms. I need time to get advice; no signing until then.
Yes, I can work within this process, but I’m not agreeing to no discount. I’d still seek one if C agrees after advice. I don’t know who can request the will.
Yes, I can work with that process. I still can’t give a firm amount or date. I’m not sure who can request the will, so perhaps the estate handler or lawyer can clarify.

Yes to the process. I can’t set fair-share terms until I’ve seen the will and had advice. I don’t know who can request the copy—please check with the estate handler or a lawyer. No signing until we all agree.
I’ll ask the estate handler or lawyer for the will and advice. I’m still not agreeing to no discount; any discount would need C’s agreement after advice.
I still can’t give a firm amount or date; I need to work out what the studio would require. I’d appreciate the timeline taking that into account.
